summary: Copilot usage metrics now show the names of the skills, custom agents, Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers, slash commands, and plugins that your organization creates, instead of grouping them under other or custom . This builds on the agentic CLI customization metrics released in September.
takeaways: Important notes Coverage: Names are reported from Copilot CLI (interactive sessions and prompt mode), the GitHub Copilot app, clients built on the Copilot SDK (e.g., VS Code and JetBrains IDEs), and Agent Client Protocol (ACP) integrations.
